name: CLM-v0.1-8B (Contrastive Language Model)

lineage.how_derived: two small projection heads (state head and action head) trained with bidirectional InfoNCE on top of a frozen Qwen3-8B; ~60M Nemotron Q&A pairs, ~30M synthetic hard negatives, ~1M agentic trajectories (card)

purpose: A 'System One' model: scores which action fits a state (computer use, gaming, tool calling) with a contrastive objective, and verifies agent trajectories after fine-tuning; much lower latency than a generative judge (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0 (card tag)
license.notes: Card tag; the Qwen3-8B encoder is served separately under its own licence.

architecture.kind: frozen Qwen3-8B encoder (served by vLLM in pooling mode, last-token, 4096-dim) + state/action projection heads (80 MB .pt)
architecture.why_this_design: Builder: states and actions are encoded separately so action embeddings can be cached; with about 1k candidates it is 13x faster than the generative baseline named in the card.

pc-12gb.variant: heads plus Qwen3-8B BF16 (estimate 8.2B x 2 bytes)
pc-12gb.notes: 16.4 GB file against 9.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; part streams from RAM (dense: decode is bandwidth bound)

pc-16gb.variant: heads plus Qwen3-8B BF16 (estimate 8.2B x 2 bytes)
pc-16gb.notes: 16.4 GB file against 13.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; part streams from RAM (dense: decode is bandwidth bound)

pc-24gb.variant: heads plus Qwen3-8B BF16 (estimate 8.2B x 2 bytes)
pc-24gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (21.6 GB)

pc-32gb.variant: heads plus Qwen3-8B BF16 (estimate 8.2B x 2 bytes)
pc-32gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (29.6 GB)

mac-16-24gb.variant: heads plus Qwen3-8B BF16 (estimate 8.2B x 2 bytes)
mac-16-24gb.notes: 16.4 GB file against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.variant: heads plus Qwen3-8B BF16 (estimate 8.2B x 2 bytes)
mac-32gb.notes: 16.4 GB file against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.variant: heads plus Qwen3-8B BF16 (estimate 8.2B x 2 bytes)
mac-64gb+.notes: 16.4 GB file against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

other: contrastive-lm package (clm-serve), vLLM pooling for the encoder

benchmarks.name: DeepSWE verifier (fine-tuned)
benchmarks.harness: card claims SOTA; also Terminal-Bench 2.1 87.6; harness not detailed in the part read

benchmarks.name: Latency vs generative judge
benchmarks.score: up to 9x lower zero-shot; 4-6x faster as verifier

weaknesses: unusual API, not a chat or embedding model
soft.maturity: 794 likes within 3 days of release, 986 downloads: much attention, little independent evidence.

tona_fit.reason: Part of the new 'System One' decision-model line (vLLM adds a /v1/systemone endpoint; llama.cpp added several 'decision' architectures). Potentially useful as a cheap verifier or router in agent loops; too new to judge.
blockers: needs a decision-model API in the server

open_questions: Who benchmarks the 'Jev' baselines named in the card
